item.title: Tems Scores Fourth No. 1 on Mainstream R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay Chart With ‘What You Need’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We've got some exciting news from the Billboard charts. Nigerian singer Tems is making waves with her latest single, "What You Need".
[Short music clip: "What You Need" by Tems]
Host: This song has just reached the top spot on Billboard's Mainstream R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay chart, marking Tems' fourth number one on this chart. It's been a huge hit on mainstream R&B and hip-hop radio stations across the US, with the most plays for the week of June 19-25.
Host: Tems is no stranger to the top of the charts. She's had previous number ones with songs like "Essence" with Wizkid, "Wait for U" with Future and Drake, and her own song "Free Mind". And now, "What You Need" is taking the crown, knocking Rick Ross, French Montana, and Max B's "Minks in Miami" down to number five.
[Short music clip: "What You Need" by Tems]
Host: But that's not all. "What You Need" is also rising on other charts, including the Adult R&B Airplay chart, where it's up to number 16, and the R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay chart, where it's holding strong at number three. And with over 16 million listeners, it's up to number 32 on the all-genre Radio Songs chart.
Host: Tems has another song on the rise, "Raindance", a collaboration with Dave. This one's climbing the Rap Airplay, Rhythmic Airplay, and R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay charts.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for this week's music update. Tems is definitely one to watch, with "What You Need" and "Raindance" making big waves on the music scene. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time.
